status: selected ideal-gas standard-state reaction thermochemistry implemented; no equilibrium solver
behavioral_choices_and_limits: ReactionStoichiometry has positive reactant and product coefficients; net coefficients are product minus reactant.
All ideal-gas species require one common reference pressure.
Only standard-state quantities are evaluated; composition, activities, non-ideal phases, electrochemistry, and pressure-dependent standard-state models are excluded.
Runtime imports only Python standard-library modules and existing pure-Python port modules.
excluded_methods_and_features: Equilibrium composition solving, element potentials, VCS/MultiPhaseEquil, and constrained-state solvers
Automatic reverse-rate installation, rate-of-progress evaluation, third bodies, falloff, and reaction parsing
Surface, interface, charged, non-ideal, and multiphase standard states
